Internal helper: a formula function given the data-first form

Source: R/checks.R
dot-jst_formula_first_stop.Rd

jt(), jaov(), jcrosstab(), jlm() and jlogistic() take a formula first. Called as the data-first functions are – jt(d, Age), jlm(d, Income, Age, Education), or under a juse() default jt(Age, Volunteer) – each stopped in R's own words, with no prefix: "object 'Age' not found", the second name read as the data and the third as paired = or subset =, each evaluated before any check saw the call (Fix Slate 31, Session 397; the (S395) item).

Usage

.jst_formula_first_stop(cl, fn, example, envir)

Arguments

cl

The call as typed (sys.call() of the exported function).

fn

The user-facing function name.

example

The function's generic formula, for the stop it has always given ("Outcome ~ Group").

envir

The caller's calling frame, where the names typed are looked up.

Value

invisible(NULL), or stops.

Details

Run first in each function, before any input is evaluated, on the call as typed. It acts only on a call with no formula in it: no argument is a ~ expression, the first input is not a formula, not a quoted formula, and no later name holds one (the swapped order, jt(d, f), keeps its own stop). Then:

  • the first input is a data frame: the names after it are the variables, and the data frame stays after the formula offered;

  • a juse() default is set and the first input is a name found nowhere or a variable of the default: every name is read as a variable of the default, and the call offered names no data frame;

  • otherwise the formula stop the caller has always given, in the same words.

A formula is offered when the names fill it – two for jt(), jaov() and jcrosstab(), two or more for jlm() and jlogistic() – each a variable of the data frame: the first as the outcome (the row variable in jcrosstab()), in the order typed, which the line above it says; the call's other named inputs kept. Otherwise the line says what the formula names, and the function's own example on community follows (.jst_formula_examples).
